resources.string: Offline speech-to-text. This build bundles offline speech recognition (the open-source whisper.cpp plus a bundled model). Turning an episode\'s audio into text happens entirely on your device — the audio is never uploaded, never leaves the device, and never passes through any server. You can turn this off in Settings.
Light up each word as it is spoken. On-device recognition produces word timings along the way, so this costs no extra transcription time.

Real spectrum (optional). Turning on "Real spectrum" in Settings makes the ink wave follow the actual loudness. That needs microphone access, which the system asks for separately when you enable it; the audio is only analysed on device — never recorded, stored or sent anywhere — and is no longer used once you turn the switch off.
